title: SB 1297 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 2-7-112 and Title 55, Chapter 50, relative to licenses.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1, 2-7-112(c)(1)
(quote) Section 2-7-112(c)(1), is amended by inserting the language "physical" immediately preceding the language "Tennessee driver license".
(section) Sec. 2, 2-7-112(c)(3)
(quote) Section 2-7-112(c)(3), is amended by inserting the language "physical," immediately after the language "A".
(section) Sec. 6, 55-50-306(e) (first sentence rewritten)
(quote) except, that to verify the person's identification for the purpose of voting, the person shall not present or submit evidence of possession of a valid driver license in a digital format, and a digital driver license must not be accepted as such evidence.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 8, 55-50-306(k) (new)
(quote) For purposes of this section, "driver license" includes a photo identification license issued under § 55-50-336.
(other) Sec. 3: 'electronic' driver licence system renamed 'digital' throughout 55-50-306.
(other) Sec. 4: 55-50-304: a new exemption for an adult accompanied by a safety department employee in a driving demonstration.
(other) Sec. 5: no fee to take part in the digital driver licence system.
(other) Sec. 6 (rest): a digital licence 'may be accepted' (Draft said 'must be accepted') for identification generally.
(other) Sec. 7: digital-licence data kept no longer than needed and never more than 3 calendar days; not sold except to law enforcement, entitled agencies or on subpoena.
(other) Sec. 8: biometric (face geometry) limits, geolocation ban, data is personal information, no one is required to use or preferred for using a digital licence, licence disabled on suspension or lost device.
(other) Sec. 9: Class D licence definition covers autocycles. Sec. 10: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 3106048-Draft: slot a (physical licence required at 2-7-112(c)(1) and (3); digital licence barred for voting ID). Draft Sec. 6 says a digital licence 'must be accepted' elsewhere; Sec. 8 biometric rules are more detailed (department may collect face geometry only to compare with the photo on file; consent each time).
(other) version: amend-234402-SA0055 (Senate Transportation & Safety amendment 1, 'adopted' flag 0): changes 'which must be accepted' to 'which may be accepted' in Sec. 6. The voting exception is unchanged.
(other) version: 3222861-Chaptered (PC 297, HB1316): has 'may be accepted' (SA0055 wording); biometric section Sec. 8(g)(2)-(3) is simpler than the Draft.
(other) note: Only one SB1297 roll call exists (Senate committee); the floor action ran on HB1316, whose roll calls are not in this bill's record. The voted version for the committee vote is inferred: the committee recommended 'with amendment/s' and SA0055 is the committee's amendment 1. Slot a text is in both the Draft and the amended text, so the voted version carries it either way. The new text limits ID to a physical licence or a physical photo ID licence (55-50-336); it does not add or remove any other accepted ID.

votes.motion: Senate Transportation & Safety Committee, recommended with amendment [version voted: Draft 3106048 + SA0055 (inferred: committee amendment 1, 'must' to 'may' accepted)]
